summary: Validated i18n auto-translate performance fix (bulk cache lookup + parallel LLM chunks + asyncio.to_thread offload). All 6 backend pytest cases pass; frontend E2E language switch English<->French completes in <0.3s. Event loop remains responsive during large uncached translation batch.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/llm_helper.py::_send_message_blocking uses asyncio.run(chat.send_message(...)) inside asyncio.to_thread. This works because it spawns a NEW event loop per worker thread — no interference with the main FastAPI loop — but it does create/tear down a fresh loop per LLM call which has small overhead. If throughput becomes an issue later, consider a persistent loop-per-thread pool or migrating emergentintegrations to a true async client. Not blocking for this fix.

backend/services/auto_translate.py::_safe_batch_chunk_size falls back to 30 on ValueError but defaults to 10 when env is unset, and clamps to [10,250]. Inconsistent fallback (10 vs 30) — minor cosmetic, does not affect correctness.
backend/routes/i18n.py auto_translate_batch has a burst-cache but no per-user/IP rate limit surfaced; ok for now since batch size is capped at 100.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_i18n_auto_translate_perf_fix.py. It generates fresh random-suffixed English strings each run so each execution costs ~55-90 LLM calls via Emergent LLM key. Perf thresholds: fresh 30-string batch <=15s, cached <=3s, event-loop worst-case /api/health <2s during in-flight translate. If run twice in rapid succession, the 2nd run may see 3-4s /api/health worst-case latency due to lingering LLM thread activity from the previous run — this is a test-order artefact, not a real regression. Run tests individually or with a 10s sleep between suite invocations for cleanest metrics.

measured_metrics.brand_protected_3_strings_french: 1.55-1.75s (RealAICoach preserved literal in all 3 French outputs)

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause identified by E1 (main agent) and validated by this test agent: (1) per-string find_one on translation_cache -> replaced with bulk $in lookup (get_cached_translations_bulk) + bulk_write upserts; (2) chunks previously processed serially -> now asyncio.gather with Semaphore(6) concurrency; (3) THE DEEPEST FIX in utils/llm_helper.py::generate_verified_json: the emergentintegrations LlmChat.send_message internally awaits SYNCHRONOUS litellm.completion, blocking the FastAPI event loop and serialising every 'parallel' LLM call. Wrapping it via asyncio.to_thread (through _send_message_blocking) restores true parallelism and keeps /api/health responsive during large batches. Fix confirmed correct: 30 fresh French strings now translate in ~5.5s (was ~16.6s for 60), health stays <300ms during translation.
